scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@waitplay/shared && npm run build --workspace=@waitplay/bridge && npm run build --workspace=@waitplay/web
scripts.dock:left: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name WaitPlay -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmd.exe /c 'apps\native\WaitPlay.exe --dock=left'; Start-Process apps\native\WaitPlay.exe -ArgumentList '--widget'"
scripts.dock:right: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name WaitPlay -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmd.exe /c 'apps\native\WaitPlay.exe --dock=right'; Start-Process apps\native\WaitPlay.exe -ArgumentList '--widget'"
scripts.dock:bottom: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name WaitPlay -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmd.exe /c 'apps\native\WaitPlay.exe --dock=bottom'; Start-Process apps\native\WaitPlay.exe -ArgumentList '--widget'"
scripts.dock:free: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name WaitPlay -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmd.exe /c 'apps\native\WaitPlay.exe --dock=free'; Start-Process apps\native\WaitPlay.exe -ArgumentList '--widget'"
